verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Zapier acting as an MCP *server* (zapier.com/mcp) that other AI clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) connect to in order to use Zapier's own tools — not Zapier acting as an MCP *client* that ingests external MCP servers so Zapier itself can call their tools. No documentation shows Zapier importing or connecting to third-party MCP servers as a consumer.
